boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-extra-purchase ways for currently enrolled Terps to spend time together on campus, plus one publicly welcoming garden stop.

cards.title: Run a court at Eppley
cards.subtitle: Eppley Recreation Center
cards.notes: Bring a currently enrolled friend, swipe your university ID, and use the basketball courts during facility access hours.
cards.short_summary: A no-extra-charge indoor court hang for students with RecWell access.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD says RecWell access is included in the student fee and identifies basketball among Eppley Recreation Center activities.
cards.source_title: Eppley Recreation Center | University Recreation & Wellness
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled students; RecWell access is included in the student fee and a university ID is used for entry.

cards.entity_name: Indoor Track at Eppley Recreation Center
cards.title: Walk laps indoors
cards.subtitle: Eppley Recreation Center
cards.notes: Meet at Eppley for a low-key walking lap session; check the facility page for current access and closure updates.
cards.short_summary: An indoor movement break that needs no separate purchase for enrolled students.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD’s catalog says access to RecWell facilities is included in the student fee and lists an indoor track at Eppley.
cards.source_title: University Recreation and Wellness | University of Maryland Catalog
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled students; bring a university ID. Facility access is included in the student fee.

cards.entity_name: Bouldering Zone at Eppley Recreation Center
cards.title: Try the bouldering zone
cards.subtitle: Eppley Recreation Center
cards.notes: Plan a short bouldering session together and follow RecWell staff guidance and posted facility safety rules.
cards.short_summary: A structured active hang inside Eppley for students already covered by RecWell.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD identifies a bouldering zone among Eppley’s activities and says RecWell access is included in the student fee.
cards.source_title: Eppley Recreation Center | University Recreation & Wellness
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled students with university ID access; follow posted RecWell requirements.

cards.title: Meet for a swim
cards.subtitle: Eppley Recreation Center Natatorium
cards.notes: Use the indoor pool for lap swimming or a relaxed aquatic break; confirm natatorium hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A pool meet-up included with student RecWell access.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD’s catalog says RecWell access is included in the student fee and that Eppley has indoor and outdoor pools for lap swimming and diving.
cards.source_title: University Recreation and Wellness | University of Maryland Catalog
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled students; university ID required. Check the Eppley page for current pool hours.

cards.title: Train at Ritchie
cards.subtitle: Ritchie Coliseum
cards.notes: Choose a cardio, weight-room, or functional-training session and meet afterward to cool down and compare routines.
cards.short_summary: A campus gym session with no separate entry purchase for enrolled students.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD says RecWell facility access is included in the student fee and locates weight rooms, cardio centers, and functional training at Ritchie Coliseum.
cards.source_title: University Recreation and Wellness | University of Maryland Catalog
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled students with a university ID; facility availability can vary.

cards.title: Move at Reckord Armory
cards.subtitle: Reckord Armory Gym
cards.notes: Make it a quick workout meet-up, then use the walk back across campus as time to catch up.
cards.short_summary: A named RecWell gym option covered through student access.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD lists Reckord Armory Gym among facilities whose access is included in the student fee.
cards.source_title: University Recreation and Wellness | University of Maryland Catalog
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled students; present a university ID to enter RecWell facilities.

cards.entity_name: Fitness Session at Regents Drive Garage Studios
cards.title: Use the Regents Drive studios
cards.subtitle: Fitness studios in Regents Drive Garage
cards.notes: Coordinate a simple gym session in the Regents Drive Garage studios and verify the space is open before meeting.
cards.short_summary: A named campus fitness-space hang included with RecWell student access.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD lists the fitness studios in Regents Drive Garage among RecWell facilities included in the student fee.
cards.source_title: University Recreation and Wellness | University of Maryland Catalog
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled students with university ID access; check RecWell for current availability.

cards.entity_name: Outdoor Recreation at La Plata Beach
cards.title: Bring a game to La Plata Beach
cards.subtitle: La Plata Beach
cards.notes: Pack a frisbee, cards, or another item you already own and use this named outdoor RecWell area for a casual meet-up.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus activity area managed through RecWell.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD identifies La Plata Beach as an outdoor recreation space it manages and says access to RecWell facilities is included in the student fee.
cards.source_title: University Recreation & Wellness | University of Maryland
cards.access_notes: For current students using RecWell outdoor space; bring only your own equipment and follow posted field rules.

cards.entity_name: Bike Repair at the RecWell Bike Shop
cards.title: Tune up a bike together
cards.subtitle: RecWell Bike Shop, Cole Student Activities Building
cards.notes: Bring your bike to the shop for help with basic maintenance, or learn a repair step alongside a friend.
cards.short_summary: A practical campus hang with free repair and maintenance support for students.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD’s catalog says the RecWell Bike Shop in the Cole Student Activities Building offers free repairs and maintenance and teaches students bike repair.
cards.source_title: University Recreation and Wellness | University of Maryland Catalog
cards.access_notes: Student-focused service; contact or visit RecWell for current shop procedures before bringing a bike.

cards.title: Pause in Moxley Gardens
cards.subtitle: Between the Riggs Alumni Center and the football stadium
cards.notes: Choose a bench for conversation, reading, or a quiet reset; enter only while the garden gates are open.
cards.short_summary: A publicly welcoming garden setting for an unhurried outdoor catch-up.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD says students and visitors are welcome to enjoy Moxley Gardens any time the gates are open, including for studying, chatting, or relaxing.
cards.source_title: Dessie M. Moxley Gardens | Arboretum Outreach Center
cards.access_notes: Students and visitors are welcome when gates are open; no admission or purchase is stated for garden enjoyment.
